summary: A SuperAdmin can cancel a running engine run, and stuck runs are reported.

new.title: Cancel a running engine run
new.text: A SuperAdmin can cancel a running engine run from the Jobs page. A cancelled run is final and never resumes.

fixes.title: Stuck runs are reported
fixes.text: A run that makes no progress for an hour is reported while it keeps running.

fixes.title: Runs continue on the new version
fixes.text: After an update, a run still on the old version is stopped and runs again on the new one.

fixes.title: Managed-tenant steps start sooner
fixes.text: The managed-tenant pull and the publish see at once when an earlier run has ended.
